title: Standalone theme control behavioural tests (AC-206-7..10 under ADR-4137)
description: Baz 2026-10-04 (w-2026-10-04-dave-001): nine node tests pinning the ADR-4137 contract. `renderPage()` emits the control in `.tools` (AC-206-7). `renderPage({ embed: true })` does not emit any `[data-rcf-theme-control]` markup (AC-206-9 server-side layer). A VM-sandboxed boot of `src/view/page-init.js` with a minimal `document`/`window`/`localStorage` shim exercises: click on a theme button updates `data-theme` live and flips `aria-pressed` (AC-206-7); non-embed boot writes `rcf-view:v1:theme` and a stored value re-applies on the next boot (AC-206-8); a `rcf-view-theme` postMessage applies live but writes nothing (AC-206-8); under `?embed=1` the control element is removed from the DOM and the storage key is zero-touched on load, on postMessage and on any user action (AC-206-9); explicit `?theme=` beats the stored value and leaves the stored key as-is (AC-206-10).
